# Generate one model for all examples; generated files remain in the build tree.
add_library(serializer_compression_models INTERFACE)
serializer_generate(TARGET serializer_compression_models SCHEMAS shared/document.serializer)

add_library(serializer_compression_example_support STATIC shared/example_support.cpp)
target_include_directories(serializer_compression_example_support PUBLIC
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/shared")
target_link_libraries(serializer_compression_example_support PUBLIC serializer_compression_models)

set(compression_examples none)
if(SERIALIZER_WITH_ZSTD)
  list(APPEND compression_examples zstd)
endif()
if(SERIALIZER_WITH_LZ4)
  list(APPEND compression_examples lz4)
endif()
if(SERIALIZER_WITH_ZLIB)
  list(APPEND compression_examples gzip zlib deflate custom)
endif()
message(STATUS "Compression examples enabled: ${compression_examples}")

add_custom_target(serializer_compression_examples)
set(compression_example_targets serializer_compression_example_support)
foreach(example IN LISTS compression_examples)
  set(target "serializer_compression_${example}")
  add_executable("${target}" "${example}/main.cpp")
  target_link_libraries("${target}" PRIVATE serializer_compression_example_support)
  add_dependencies(serializer_compression_examples "${target}")
  list(APPEND compression_example_targets "${target}")
  add_test(NAME "${target}" COMMAND "${target}")
  set_tests_properties("${target}" PROPERTIES LABELS serializer_compression_examples TIMEOUT 60)
endforeach()

foreach(target IN LISTS compression_example_targets)
  if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options("${target}" PRIVATE /W4 /WX)
  else()
    target_compile_options("${target}" PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wpedantic)
  endif()
endforeach()
